methodology: Ten source-linked actor/source claim instances from the merged noon locker, checked against noncanonical Evidence Integration #338, prior Claims addenda, contemporaneous Reuters/AP/Al Jazeera and governing doctrine. Claims are split into atomic propositions and exact source/statement clocks. A journalist verifying that an actor spoke is not independent verification of claimed effects. Proposals, corrections, estimates, strike effects and knowledge are adjudicated separately. Proposed WOL edges are referrals only, not WOL-native awards/incidents. Repetition never increments unique-lie metrics. Original Persian/Arabic and actor knowledge gaps are explicit.

candidates.actor: Esmaeil Baghaei (Nov 2 Reuters attribution) and Abbas Araghchi (Oct 31 Al Jazeera quote relayed Nov 2)
candidates.statement_and_publication_clock: Reuters Nov 2 09:33Z initial article; Baghaei Monday date-only; Araghchi two-day statement quoted from Saturday Oct31; original Persian minutes not recovered
candidates.reported_wording: Baghaei: no agreement or secure Hormuz reopening unless US blockade ends and Iranian demands are addressed; faster seven-step proposal possible. Reuters explicitly attributes the specific two-day instead-of-seven-day statement to Araghchi's Saturday Al Jazeera interview, not a direct Baghaei quote.
atomic_propositions: Iran offered conditional faster reopening: attributed statement SUPPORTED
Baghaei personally stated the exact two-day promise: NOT ESTABLISHED by Reuters attribution
US accepted, signed or executed reopening: NOT ESTABLISHED
candidates.prior_membership: REPEAT/MUTATION of Sep25 seven-day Araghchi proposal and Oct31/Nov1 two-day Doha family; no new completed agreement, no unique lie
candidates.documentary_comparison: Reuters Sep25 directly quotes Araghchi's conditional seven-day proposal; Nov2 Reuters distinguishes Baghaei's conditional terms from Araghchi's Saturday two-day timeline; Doha mediation ended without breakthrough. A draft is not a signed deal.
candidates.speaker_knowledge_evidence: Diplomats may possess negotiating drafts but original signed text, US acceptance and delivery receipts absent; no proof of knowledge of a false implementation claim.
candidates.correction_and_repetition_review: Source-fidelity correction needed in ROOK intake and future Claims chain: split two-day attribution from Baghaei's Nov2 remarks; do not silently rewrite earlier speaker node. No official retraction located.
candidates.qualification_needed: Original Baghaei Persian press transcript and Araghchi Oct31 Al Jazeera recording, US/Qatar/Oman signed acceptance, navigation implementation records.
